name: labs/ymzds__niscope-mcp
title: NI PXIe oscilloscope (niscope DirectBackend)
intro: NI PXIe oscilloscope (niscope DirectBackend), adapted from ymzds/niscope-mcp. It reads `device_model`; sets `channel_enabled`, `vertical_range`, `vertical_offset`, `vertical_coupling` and 7 more; runs `measure_waveform` and `auto_setup`. `measure_waveform`: acquire one channel and return its scalar waveform measurements. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
serve_http: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/ymzds__niscope-mcp --backend fake --port 7400
serve_mcp: PYTHONPATH=mhs/MHS/sdk/src python3 -m mhs serve mhs/MHS/drivers/labs/ymzds__niscope-mcp --backend fake --mcp
